The error occurs because R8 code shrinking is enabled for release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), which strips generic `Signature` metadata and merges/optimizes anonymous inner subclasses of Gson's `TypeToken`. Consequently, `TypeToken` cannot resolve generic type arguments at runtime.

### Fix
Updated [proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r3/work/app/proguard-rules.pro) to:
1. Preserve generic `Signature`, `*Annotation*`, `InnerClasses`, and `EnclosingMethod` attributes.
2. Keep `com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken` and all subclasses/anonymous inner classes extending it.
3. Keep the model classes in `vn.shelftap.lab.model.**` and serialized fields so Gson reflection can deserialize the JSON payload without fields being stripped or renamed.
